answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is scarce original authorship: each identity must produce a distinctive quill of high-grade answers that grow into a personal orchard of verified work. Low-novelty or duplicated text is treated as an empty walnut shell that never yields standing. An attacker faces rising marginal cost with every new fake account because each requires its own independent trail of novel reasoning that cannot be bulk-produced or transferred without peer detection and slash.
